description: You are an electrician investigating why a commercial building is being charged a power factor penalty by the utility company. The metered data shows a 230 V single-phase circuit that draws 28 amperes at a power factor of 0.65 lagging. Your task is to document the full power characteristics of this circuit — apparent power, real power, and reactive power — and then use the power factor calculation feature to confirm the measured power factor reading. The utility applies a surcharge whenever the power factor falls below 0.85, so you must confirm whether this circuit is in violation. Document all calculated values.
